classes.name: Players
classes.doc: The service holding one Player per connected player. In one process the players are simulated: the harness adds them, and the first one is the client's LocalPlayer.

properties.name: LocalPlayer
properties.doc: The player this client runs for; nil on the server. Set in the client world when the local player arrives.

properties.name: CharacterAutoLoads
properties.doc: When true, a character is loaded for each player as they join.

properties.name: RespawnTime
properties.doc: Seconds between a character's death and the next one; the character work reads it.

properties.name: MaxPlayers
properties.doc: The most players a server takes.

methods.name: GetPlayerFromCharacter
methods.doc: The player whose Character is the given model, or nil.

methods.name: GetPlayerByUserId
methods.doc: The player with this UserId, or nil.

methods.name: GetUserIdFromNameAsync
methods.doc: Needs an online service; raises RE9002 at once.

methods.name: GetNameFromUserIdAsync
methods.doc: Needs an online service; raises RE9002 at once.

methods.name: GetUserThumbnailAsync
methods.doc: Needs an online service; raises RE9002 at once.

methods.name: GetFriendsAsync
methods.doc: Needs an online service; raises RE9002 at once.

events.name: PlayerAdded
events.doc: Fires with each player that joins, after the Player is in the tree.

events.name: PlayerRemoving
events.doc: Fires with each player that is leaving, while the Player can still be read.

events.name: PlayerMembershipChanged
events.note: Never fires: there are no memberships offline.
events.doc: Fires when a player's membership changes; offline it never does.

classes.name: Player
classes.doc: One connected player, under Players. Simulated in one process.

properties.name: UserId
properties.doc: The player's account number. Simulated players have -1, -2 and so on, as in a local test server.

properties.name: DisplayName
properties.doc: The name shown above the player's character.

properties.name: Character
properties.doc: The player's current character model, or nil.

properties.name: CharacterAppearanceId
properties.doc: The account whose look the character takes.

properties.name: Neutral
properties.doc: True when the player is on no team. Setting Team or TeamColor makes it false.

properties.name: Team
properties.doc: The Team under Teams whose TeamColor is the player's, or nil when the player is neutral or no team has that colour. Setting a Team takes its TeamColor and clears Neutral; setting nil makes the player neutral.

properties.name: TeamColor
properties.doc: The colour of the player's team. Setting it clears Neutral, which puts the player on the team of that colour.

properties.name: RespawnLocation
properties.doc: The SpawnLocation the player spawns at, when set.

properties.name: AccountAge
properties.doc: Days since the account was made; 0 for simulated players.

properties.name: MembershipType
properties.doc: The account's membership; None for simulated players.

properties.name: AutoJumpEnabled
properties.doc: Whether the character jumps over obstacles by itself on touch devices.

properties.name: CanLoadCharacterAppearance
properties.doc: Whether characters take the account's look.

properties.name: CameraMaxZoomDistance
properties.doc: The farthest the default camera zooms out.

properties.name: CameraMinZoomDistance
properties.doc: The nearest the default camera zooms in.

properties.name: CameraMode
properties.doc: Whether the default camera is free or locked in first person.

properties.name: HealthDisplayDistance
properties.doc: How far away the player sees other characters' health.

properties.name: NameDisplayDistance
properties.doc: How far away the player sees other characters' names.

properties.name: LocaleId
properties.doc: The player's language and region.

methods.name: LoadCharacterAsync
methods.doc: Removes the current character, if any, and spawns a new one at a SpawnLocation. Server only.

methods.name: Kick
methods.doc: Removes the player from the server, with an optional message written to the output. A client can kick only its own player.

methods.name: Move
methods.note: Forwards to the character's Humanoid:Move; does nothing without a character or Humanoid. Raises RE9001 until the Humanoid implements Move.
methods.doc: Makes the character walk in a direction, through its Humanoid.

methods.name: GetNetworkPing
methods.doc: The round-trip time to the player's client in seconds: 0 in one process.

methods.name: HasAppearanceLoaded
methods.doc: True once the character's look has loaded; simulated players load at once.

methods.name: IsInGroup
methods.doc: Needs an online service; raises RE9002 at once.

methods.name: GetRankInGroup
methods.doc: Needs an online service; raises RE9002 at once.

methods.name: GetRoleInGroup
methods.doc: Needs an online service; raises RE9002 at once.

methods.name: IsFriendsWith
methods.doc: Needs an online service; raises RE9002 at once.

events.name: CharacterAdded
events.doc: Fires when a new character is placed in the world, with the model.

events.name: CharacterRemoving
events.doc: Fires just before the character is removed, with the model.

events.name: CharacterAppearanceLoaded
events.doc: Fires after CharacterAdded once the character's look is applied.

events.name: Chatted
events.doc: Fires with each chat message the player sends.

classes.name: Backpack
classes.doc: Holds a player's tools. Filled from StarterPack each time the character spawns.

classes.name: PlayerGui
classes.doc: Holds a player's screen interfaces on their client. Filled from StarterGui when the character spawns.

classes.name: PlayerScripts
classes.doc: Holds the scripts copied from StarterPlayerScripts when the player joins. It exists only on the player's client.

classes.name: StarterPack
classes.doc: Tools copied into each player's Backpack when their character spawns.

classes.name: ForceField
classes.doc: Protects the character it is in from damage. LoadCharacter adds one for the spawn's Duration.

properties.name: Visible
properties.doc: Whether the field is drawn.

classes.name: Team
classes.doc: A side players can be on, as a child of Teams. A player who is not neutral is on the first team whose TeamColor is the player's.

properties.name: TeamColor
properties.doc: The team's colour: its players' TeamColor, and the colour of the spawns they use.

properties.name: AutoAssignable
properties.doc: When true, a player who joins may be put on this team: the auto-assignable team with the fewest players, the first in child order on a tie. With no such team the player joins neutral.

methods.name: GetPlayers
methods.doc: The players on the team, in join order.

events.name: PlayerAdded
events.doc: Fires with a player who came onto the team (by Team, TeamColor or Neutral, a team's colour changing, or joining the game), once a frame on each side.

events.name: PlayerRemoved
events.doc: Fires with a player who left the team, the game included, once a frame on each side.

methods.name: GetTeams
methods.doc: The Team children, in child order.
